hyperedges.description: Host app calls POST /internal/dashboard/session with Authentication credentials; Dashboard calls GET /api/auth/session on Authentication module to verify identity; Authentication is the source of truth, request-body identity fields are ignored.

Every workspace request re-validates the Dashboard session AND re-calls Authentication via GET /api/auth/session; rejects on user mismatch, expired auth, or blocked sessions; refreshes role and authSessionId from verified identity.

When no external auth URL is configured, mock auth provides an in-process GET /api/auth/session endpoint keyed off X-Demo-Auth-User header; mock users (Mina Rahimi, Ari Morgan) are static; mock session state lives in MOCK_AUTH_SESSIONS dict, never persisted.

Every protected endpoint routes through require_session (FastAPI Depends), which internally runs require_auth_identity, which calls normalize_auth_identity; this chain enforces user.id == session.userId and rejects blocked/expired/unsupported auth states.

DashboardRepository depends on DatabaseAdapter Protocol (not SQLite directly); SQLiteAdapter is the current implementation; a Postgres adapter can be dropped in by implementing DatabaseAdapter without changing repository code.

db.py DDL creates exactly two tables: dashboard_sessions (session state, role binding, disclaimer) and workspace_events (audit trail with FK to sessions); DDL also drops legacy tables and adds missing columns for idempotent migration.

MODULE_BUTTONS defines role-scoped button id/title sets (PSYCHIATRIST: add-new-patient, patient-follow-up, list-of-patients, setting; ADMIN: add-new-user, logs, backup, list-of-users). Buttons carry routeDiscovery metadata pointing to /internal/dashboard/module-routes/{moduleId}, which returns /modules/{moduleId} with placeholder:true.

nodes.label: Dashboard Module (v1.2.0)
nodes.excerpt: Dashboard is a workspace router — a thin, embeddable FastAPI app that verifies an Authentication session over REST, binds it to a Dashboard-local session, and returns a role-scoped workspace shell with placeholder buttons that discover downstream module routes.

nodes.label: Authentication Module (External)
nodes.excerpt: Dashboard never imports Authentication code, decodes JWTs, reads an auth DB, or implements downstream module workflows.
